# ConfirmationCode

Text whose characters appear one at a time, 13ms apart, each rising half a line and settling with a slight overshoot. Screen readers get the whole code at once.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/confirmationcode)

## Usage

```tsx
Confirmation #<ConfirmationCode code="K7RM2XQ4P" />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | `string` | The text. |
| `active` | `boolean` | Hidden until true. |
| `delay` | `number` | Milliseconds before the first character. Default 300. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `ConfirmationCode.module.css`
- `ConfirmationCode.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
